settings.title: Settings
settings.nodeHint: Changes apply the next time a project starts.
settings.https.enabledNote: Ordinary projects use HTTP. When on, projects declaring needsHttps and supportsPerformerUrl use the trusted HTTPS entry at their next start; projects needing HTTPS without full-URL support ask before continuing over HTTP.
settings.https.portInvalid: Enter a non-privileged port between {{min}} and {{max}}.
settings.https.domainInvalid: Enter a real DNS domain (like show.example.org) — no IP address, .local name, scheme or port.
settings.https.noneStored: No certificate imported yet. Import the full chain and its matching private key; they are stored protected on this Mac and never leave it.
settings.https.subject: Subject
settings.https.fileValidNote: Passing these checks means the files are valid and publicly trusted — phone usability additionally needs the router DNS and a real-device scan test before the show.
settings.https.expiresIn_one: — {{count}} day left, renew before the next performance
settings.https.expiresIn_other: — {{count}} days left, renew before the next performance
settings.https.status.wrongDomain: Certificate does not cover the configured domain
settings.https.problem.parse: The certificate or key files are not usable PEM material.
settings.https.problem.expired: The certificate's validity period has ended.
settings.https.problem.notYetValid: The certificate's validity period has not started yet.
settings.https.problem.domainMismatch: The certificate does not cover the configured domain.
settings.https.problem.incompleteChain: The certificate chain is incomplete — import the full chain.
settings.https.problem.notPubliclyTruste: The chain does not root in a publicly trusted CA; phones will not trust it.
settings.https.problem.keyMismatch: The private key does not match the certificate.
settings.https.local.domainRequired: Fill in the domain first — the certificate is validated against it.
settings.https.local.saveFailed: Could not save the domain. Try again before preparing HTTPS.
settings.https.local.loadFailed: Could not read the certificate state. Reopen this section to try again.
settings.https.local.importFailed: Could not import the certificate. Try again.
settings.https.local.clearFailed: Could not clear the certificate. Try again.
settings.https.dnsHint: Point the domain at this Mac: on the performance router's local DNS, resolve {{lanIp}} for it. Performers only join Wi-Fi and scan — no certificate installs, VPN or phone-side DNS edits.
settings.https.hint: Applies at the next project start — a running performance keeps its current entry and certificate.
settings.dns.title: Performance DNS
settings.dns.intro: No phone-side setup: once the router points DNS at this Mac, the performance domain resolves to the venue entry and everyday browsing keeps flowing.
settings.dns.enabledNote: First enable needs one-time system approval. Ordinary forwarding continues after stopping a project or leaving the PNDS window; the Mac must stay on and online. Disabling unregisters the daemon — restoring everyday internet means pointing the router's DNS back (see help).
settings.dns.status.enabled: Enabled — restored on login and reboot
settings.dns.status.requiresApproval: Awaiting system approval — approve in System Settings
settings.dns.status.notFound: Daemon not found — reinstall the app
settings.dns.mappingNone: No performance mapping — installed automatically when a performance starts with its entry ready
settings.dns.statusUnavailable: Status unavailable — the service is not installed or not ready yet

creation.newProject.readmeBody: This is a blank PNDS project. Test it manually in the creation workspace, then create its score, interaction and sound.
creation.newProject.pageMessage: No score or performer controls have been added yet.
creation.newProject.agentHint: This is a blank score project. Replace its technical placeholders with the piece's own implementation; keep the PNDS runtime contract.

creation.compile.unsaved: Save or reload SCD and manifest drafts before compiling: {{paths}}
creation.compile.runtimeBusy: Wait for the current runtime operation to finish.
creation.compile.syncFailed: Could not synchronize project files before compilation.
creation.compile.verified: Compilation verified against all declared references.
creation.compile.restart: Restart manually to use these artifacts; the current runtime keeps its loaded version.
creation.bundle.savedOnly: Includes saved files only; unsaved drafts do not enter the bundle.
creation.bundle.drafts: Unsaved drafts will not be included. Save them first to include these changes, or continue with the saved files.
creation.bundle.untested: No successful test has been recorded for this workspace. We recommend testing the saved project first. You can still generate the bundle.
creation.bundle.version: Increase the project version whenever its content changes before distributing a new bundle.
creation.modules.hint: Choose the technical capability your project needs. Add its files, then let an external agent wire and verify it.
creation.modules.complete: Module files added and wiring task recorded. Wiring and runtime validation remain pending.
creation.modules.partial: Module files added, but the handoff was not recorded. Fix the error, reload status and retry the handoff; existing files will be preserved.
creation.modules.saveDraftFirst: Save or resolve unsaved module/handoff drafts, then reload module status.
creation.modules.state.added: Files added; see the handoff for actual wiring and validation evidence
creation.modules.state.needsHandoff: Files added; handoff still needs recording
creation.modules.state.conflict: Target conflict: existing files preserved; ask an external agent to merge
creation.modules.description.qr: Requires qrcode. Wire the resolved full performer URL, PNG route and your monitor UI.
creation.modules.description.players: Requires Socket.IO and its browser client. Wire server identity/protocol and performer client; choose project events, persistence and audio adapters. Template seats and channels are examples.
creation.modules.description.themeFollow: No runtime dependencies. Wire monitor only, choose CSS mapping or a drawing callback, and use Host first-frame theme and idempotent messages.
creation.modules.description.localeFollo: No runtime dependencies. Wire monitor only; supply project strings, supported languages and fallback using Host locale messages.
creation.modules.description.monitorStat: Requires Socket.IO and its browser client. Wire a monitor namespace, declare low-frequency view keys and wait for snapshots; state ends with the score server.
creation.modules.olderVersion: App provides {{version}}. Keep the installed source; ask an external agent to review an upgrade.
creation.modules.description.hub: Optional Socket.IO hub connection using the Host node configuration. Wire remote events and summaries with your own adapters; local performer control remains independent.
creation.libraries.hint: Adopt an exact version of an App shared package. The reference and new project version are saved together; wiring stays under your control.
creation.libraries.kind.browser: Browser runtime: serve it from your project’s own HTTP / HTTPS origin.
creation.libraries.kind.node: Node production dependency: load its verified local entry in the score server.
creation.libraries.fixedVersion: App candidate version: {{version}}. Work compatibility must be validated before release.
creation.libraries.wiring: See the reference manual’s App shared package wiring example. No author source is changed and no library is copied into your project. Models remain in the project.
creation.libraries.alreadyAdded: This exact reference is already adopted.
creation.libraries.complete: Reference and project version saved. Wire and test the project, then restart to use the saved change.
creation.libraries.saveDraftFirst: Save or resolve the manifest draft before adopting an App shared package.
creation.libraries.purpose.p5: Canvas drawing, animation and page input.
creation.libraries.purpose.ml5: Browser machine learning; model files stay in your project.
creation.libraries.purpose.express: HTTP routes and static files for your score server.
creation.libraries.purpose.qrcode: Generate QR codes for the project’s joining address.
creation.libraries.purpose.socket.io: Realtime events between the score server and browsers.
creation.libraries.purpose.socket.io-cli: Connect browser or Node clients to a Socket.IO server.
creation.libraries.purpose.osc-min: Encode and decode OSC messages for your project’s UDP transport.
creation.modules.sourceNote: Added files do not establish wiring or runtime validation. The project owns its sources; App updates preserve them.
creation.modules.handoffNote: Each module’s pnds-module.json records its source; wiring tasks go to docs/creator-handoff.md. An external agent handles dependencies, entry references, merges, upgrades and removal.
creation.modules.summary.qr: Display the current project’s performer joining address in the monitor.
creation.modules.boundary.qr: Use the project’s resolved complete address. QR dimensions, output and placement are chosen by the work.
creation.modules.wiring.qr: Pass the actual performer URL to the QR generator and connect its output to your monitor display.
creation.modules.verification.qr: Check the complete address, scan to join, and repeat under the project’s different network configurations.
creation.modules.summary.players: Joining, rejection, reconnect and identity recovery, with separate observer connections.
creation.modules.boundary.players: The project chooses identity, seats and sound recovery. Continuous filtering is optional; repeated discrete actions are delivered separately.
creation.modules.wiring.players: Connect page and server callbacks for joining, rejection, disconnection and recovery. Keep monitor observers separate from performer identities.
creation.modules.verification.players: Check joining and rejection, reconnect, persistent identity recovery, observer isolation, and repeated action delivery.
creation.modules.summary.themeFollow: Apply App themes through CSS or the work’s own drawing callback.
creation.modules.boundary.themeFollow: Missing or unknown messages preserve a reasonable default. Only the monitor follows; the performer keeps the work’s own theme.
creation.modules.wiring.themeFollow: Connect Host theme messages to monitor CSS or drawing callbacks, preserving a default for standalone opening.
creation.modules.verification.themeFollo: Check the initial theme, repeat delivery, switching, malformed messages and standalone opening. Verify performer independence and cleanup.
creation.modules.summary.localeFollow: Receive the App language and pass it to the page’s own translations.
creation.modules.boundary.localeFollow: The project owns translations and fallback. Only the monitor follows; performer language stays project-controlled.
creation.modules.wiring.localeFollow: Connect the resolved Host language to monitor translations and update callbacks, including default and unknown-language handling.
creation.modules.verification.localeFoll: Check the first frame, language changes, repeat and malformed messages, standalone opening, performer independence and cleanup.
creation.modules.summary.monitorState: Share declared view settings across multiple monitor copies.
creation.modules.boundary.monitorState: Late or reconnected copies receive the current snapshot. Local transient state stays local; shared state ends with the server session.
creation.modules.wiring.monitorState: Declare synchronized view keys, connect server snapshots and broadcasts, and apply them through monitor callbacks.
creation.modules.verification.monitorSta: Check two monitors, late joining, reconnect, unknown keys, server restart and cleanup. Performers must not receive this channel.
creation.modules.summary.hub: Connect remote project nodes and observe connection recovery and summary freshness.
creation.modules.boundary.hub: Remote nodes differ from local phones. The project handles event meaning and remote state; local controls continue when the hub fails.
creation.modules.wiring.hub: Use Host node configuration for hub authentication, event callbacks, node summaries and expiry cleanup. The work chooses remote-state adoption and disconnection behavior.
creation.modules.verification.hub: Check two nodes, authentication and room isolation, loss and recovery, summary expiry and stop cleanup. Local performers must still control with an unreachable hub.
